title: Public Enforcement and Initial Public Offering Reporting Quality in Weak Institutional Environments: Evidence from a Random Experiment in China
authors: Manyi Fan; Kai Guo; Bin Ke
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional randomized design, not staggered DiD. Tables 1-7 and 9 regress application outcomes on 'selected' (randomly drawn for on-site inspection) with application-level controls and industry / draw FE. The deterrence test (Table 8 Panel C) is a cross-section of IPO applicants: random = STAR-board applicant, post = application_date >= 1 Nov 2020 (one common date, setup_data_main.do lines 176-187), reghdfe y random random_post + time-varying firm controls, absorb(ind app_yearmonth); a pooled treated-group dummy replaces unit FE (not eligible, as in mnsc.2022.04062), plus a PSM-matched sample in columns 3-4.
design_notes: CSRC random pre-IPO on-site inspection draws 2014-2022; application-level data from Wind, CSMAR, Choice, RESSET.
estimators_reported: common-date cross-sectional DiD with controls (full and PSM samples)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Deterrence post date is 1 Nov 2020 for all STAR-board applicants.
data_files_note: Readme: data must be purchased (Wind, CSMAR, Choice, DIB, RESSET) or hand-collected; package ships code and logs only.
software_notes: Stata master.do with table do-files; R for Figure 1.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Random-draw cross-section; deterrence DiD has a single date and no unit FE.
